title: Have I Been Pwned or a Commercial Breach Monitoring Service?
excerpt: Have I Been Pwned is a free, widely used way to check whether email addresses appear in known breaches. Commercial services watch more sources continuously. Here is when each is enough.
verdict: Have I Been Pwned is an excellent free starting point for individuals and small teams, including domain-wide notifications once you verify a domain. Commercial breach monitoring is worth paying for when a large organisation needs continuous coverage of more sources, such as criminal forums and markets, with analyst support.
